title: Parker Pipeline — Trump Supporter Debate Archive
description: Searchable archive of Parker's debate livestreams: transcripts, speaker-tagged utterances, keyword analytics, and topic heatmaps.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: All ingested Parker streams with metadata

utterances.title: Transcript
utterances.description: Every utterance with speaker tags, timestamps, and YouTube links

pipeline_state.title: Pipeline Status
pipeline_state.description: Processing state per video per phase

search_transcript.title: Search Transcripts (FTS5)
search_transcript.sql: SELECT u.video_id, u.speaker, u.chapter, printf('%d:%02d:%02d', CAST(u.start_sec/3600 AS INT), CAST((u.start_sec%3600)/60 AS INT), CAST(u.start_sec%60 AS INT)) as timestamp, substr(u.text, 1, 200) as snippet, 'https://youtu.be/' || u.video_id || '?t=' || CAST(u.start_sec AS INT) as youtube_link FROM utterances u JOIN utterances_fts fts ON u.id = fts.rowid WHERE utterances_fts MATCH :query ORDER BY rank LIMIT 50

keyword_mentions.title: Keyword Mention Count
keyword_mentions.description: Count keyword appearances broken down by speaker
keyword_mentions.sql: SELECT speaker, COUNT(*) as utterances, SUM((length(text) - length(replace(lower(text), lower(:keyword), ''))))/length(:keyword) as total_mentions FROM utterances WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%' || lower(:keyword) || '%' GROUP BY speaker ORDER BY total_mentions DESC

topic_heatmap.title: Topic Mentions by Video
topic_heatmap.description: Count topic keyword mentions per video
topic_heatmap.sql: SELECT v.title, v.video_id, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%economy%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%tariff%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%inflation%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%tax%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%trade%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as economy, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%immigra%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%border%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%deport%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as immigration, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%abort%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%trans %' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%gender%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%gun %' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%lgbtq%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as social_issues, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%epstein%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%deep state%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%qanon%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%rigged%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as conspiracy, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%climate%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%environment%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%energy%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as environment, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%vote%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%elect%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%democrat%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%republican%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as election FROM utterances u JOIN videos v ON u.video_id = v.video_id GROUP BY v.video_id

guest_leaderboard.title: Guest Leaderboard
guest_leaderboard.description: Most active guests: utterances, estimated words, airtime
guest_leaderboard.sql: SELECT u.video_id, u.speaker, COUNT(*) as utterances, CAST(SUM(length(u.text))/5 AS INTEGER) as est_words, CAST((MAX(u.end_sec) - MIN(u.start_sec))/60 AS INTEGER) as duration_min, printf('%d:%02d:%02d', CAST(MIN(u.start_sec)/3600 AS INT), CAST((MIN(u.start_sec)%3600)/60 AS INT), CAST(MIN(u.start_sec)%60 AS INT)) as first_appearance FROM utterances u WHERE u.speaker != 'parker' GROUP BY u.video_id, u.speaker ORDER BY utterances DESC

epstein_tracker.title: Epstein Mentions
epstein_tracker.description: Every Epstein reference with YouTube deep-link
epstein_tracker.sql: SELECT u.video_id, u.speaker, u.chapter, printf('%d:%02d:%02d', CAST(u.start_sec/3600 AS INT), CAST((u.start_sec%3600)/60 AS INT), CAST(u.start_sec%60 AS INT)) as timestamp, substr(u.text, 1, 200) as snippet, 'https://youtu.be/' || u.video_id || '?t=' || CAST(u.start_sec AS INT) as youtube_link FROM utterances u WHERE lower(u.text) LIKE '%epstein%' ORDER BY u.video_id, u.start_sec

recent_activity.title: Recent Pipeline Activity
recent_activity.sql: SELECT video_id, phase, status, started_at, finished_at, error FROM pipeline_state WHERE started_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20
